ordinal_regression.summary: Grades the coming move from strong down to strong up and predicts the grade with one weighted vote and a ladder of cut points; P(up) is the chance of landing above zero.
ordinal_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: a cumulative-link (proportional odds) model; P(up) = 1 - P(grade <= K/2), the model's own chance the move is above 0. Differs from the spec: the grades are cut from the scaled h-bar move with a threshold at exactly 0 (the Cycle's label is up or down). Expect: close to logistic regression; with one grade per side it is logistic regression.

grades_per_side.label: Grades per side
grades_per_side.description: How many ordered grades the moves below 0 and above 0 are each cut into (training quantiles). 1 is plain logistic regression.

cumulative_link.label: Link
cumulative_link.description: The latent error's distribution: logistic (proportional odds) or normal (ordered probit).

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

multinomial_logistic_regression.summary: Three weighted votes (down, flat, up) turned into three probabilities that add to one; P(up) is up's share once flat is set aside.
multinomial_logistic_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: softmax over down / flat / up classes of the scaled move; P(up) = p_up / (p_up + p_down). Differs from the spec: the flat band is a training quantile of |move|, because the Cycle's label is up or down. Expect: close to logistic regression; p_flat carries no direction.

neutral_band_quantile.label: Flat band (quantile of |move|)
neutral_band_quantile.description: Moves smaller than this training quantile of the absolute move form the flat class.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

generalized_linear_model.summary: One weighted vote passed through a chosen link curve (logistic, normal, complementary log-log or Cauchy) to give P(up); the forecast line is the Gaussian member.
generalized_linear_model.implementationNote: Bridge: a Binomial GLM on the up / down label fitted by IRLS; P(up) = inverse link of the vote. Differs from the spec: the family is fixed by the task (Binomial for direction, Gaussian identity for the price line); the link is the choice. Expect: logit and probit equal the logistic and probit keys; cloglog and cauchit tilt the tails.

link_function.label: Link
link_function.description: The curve from the weighted vote to P(up): logit, probit, complementary log-log (asymmetric) or cauchit (heavy tails).

penalty_strength.label: Penalty strength
penalty_strength.description: L2 (ridge) penalty on the weights, per bar; 0 fits the plain maximum-likelihood GLM by IRLS.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

gamma_regression.summary: Two models of move size, one for up moves and one for down moves; the side expected to be bigger sets the direction.
gamma_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: fitted twice (up and down magnitudes, log link); direction is the contest of the two means, calibrated on validation. Differs from the spec: a Gamma model has no sign, so the sign comes from the contest. Expect: weak direction; the size models carry most of the content.

penalty_strength.label: Penalty strength
penalty_strength.description: L2 (ridge) penalty on the weights, per bar; 0 fits the plain maximum-likelihood GLM by IRLS.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

poisson_regression.summary: Counts the up bars and the down bars expected in the next h bars; the Skellam chance that up bars outnumber down bars sets the direction.
poisson_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: fitted twice (up-bar and down-bar counts, log link); P(up side wins) from the Skellam difference, calibrated on validation. Differs from the spec: counts are bars that close a tick up or down. Expect: it predicts which side has more bars, not the sign of the h-bar move.

penalty_strength.label: Penalty strength
penalty_strength.description: L2 (ridge) penalty on the weights, per bar; 0 fits the plain maximum-likelihood GLM by IRLS.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

tweedie_regression.summary: Models the up part and the down part of the move, each a mix of 'exactly zero' and a positive size; the chance each part is nonzero sets the direction.
tweedie_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: Tweedie GLMs on max(move, 0) and max(-move, 0); P(up) = P(u > 0) / (P(u > 0) + P(d > 0)) from each side's zero mass exp(-mu^(2-p) / (phi (2-p))). Differs from the spec: the zero mass is a sign, not a claim count. Expect: probabilities close to 0.5.

variance_power.label: Variance power p
variance_power.description: Between 1 (Poisson) and 2 (Gamma): how the spread grows with the mean.

penalty_strength.label: Penalty strength
penalty_strength.description: L2 (ridge) penalty on the weights, per bar; 0 fits the plain maximum-likelihood GLM by IRLS.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

zero_inflated_poisson.summary: Counts the large up bars and the large down bars expected in the next h bars, allowing extra 'quiet market' zeros; the side expected to have more sets the direction.
zero_inflated_poisson.implementationNote: Bridge: fitted twice (up and down impulse counts); direction is the contest of the two expected counts, calibrated on validation. Differs from the spec: a failed zero-inflated fit falls back to Poisson, logged. Expect: it predicts which side has more large bars, not the sign of the h-bar move.

impulse_multiple.label: Impulse size (x bar scale)
impulse_multiple.description: A bar counts as an impulse when its move is beyond this multiple of the trailing one-bar scale.

max_iterations.label: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most steps the solver takes to find the weights.

multivariate_regression.summary: Forecasts the move at several horizons at once from the same features, sharing their errors; P(up) is the chance the h-bar forecast lands above zero.
multivariate_regression.implementationNote: Bridge: ridge on J horizons h/J..h with the residual covariance; P(up) = Phi(y_h / sd_h). Differs from the spec: only the h-bar column is scored; the others act through the shared covariance and the optional reduced rank. Expect: close to ridge regression with a probability of its own.

horizon_count.label: Horizons
horizon_count.description: How many horizons up to h are forecast together.

reduced_rank.label: Reduced rank
reduced_rank.description: Rank of the coefficient matrix; 0 keeps the full rank.

penalty_strength.label: Penalty strength
penalty_strength.description: Ridge penalty added to X'X; larger is simpler.
